meta.title: Models helper
meta.description: Clone built-in providers into custom providers whose models, parameters and prices stay in sync with models.dev and OpenRouter. Review field-level updates in Settings → Models, lock fields, edit prices, and see per-turn and per-session cost in conversations. Agent tools can read status and diffs and apply changes only after your approval. The plugin contacts the network only for clone, check-update and cache-refresh actions.
